rulesAudit.summary: Scoped half-step numeric widening preserves strict schemas, ownership, bounded counts/sums and paired atomic transitions. No finding in independent diff review.

personaReview.artifact: Compiled half-star slider in demo and real finder
personaReview.headline: A quick half-star selection stays distinct from a saved rating and does not claim checked conditions.
personaReview.in_character_reaction: I can drag or use the keys, see the half star, and submit when ready. A blank slider state is clearly unrated. The rating still says it is an opinion, with the existing condition limits visible.

captureNote: Flow and overflow checked at320/390x844; screenshots use taller capture viewports to show full rating controls below normal sticky header.
visualReview: Inspected all four320/390px demo and real rating screenshots. Numeric4.5 value, clipped half-filled star, range track, and explicit Update/Remove controls are legible, with no identity information. No horizontal overflow at either tested mobile width.
